saints.name: St. Charles Borromeo
saints.title: Bishop
saints.shortBlurb: The reforming Archbishop of Milan who turned the decrees of the Council of Trent into pastoral fact…
biography: Born in 1538 of a noble Lombard family and nephew of Pope Pius IV, Charles was made a cardinal and administrator of Milan while still young. As the pope's close counsellor he laboured for the successful conclusion of the Council of Trent, and thereafter he devoted himself to carrying its reforms into practice.

As Archbishop of Milan he founded seminaries for the training of priests, held synods, catechized the young, visited the remotest parishes of his vast diocese, and gave himself heroically to the plague-stricken of Milan in 1576. Worn out by labour and penance, he died on 4 November 1584. He is a patron of bishops, seminarians, and catechists.
saints.knownFor: Reforming the Church after Trent as Archbishop of Milan.
